sentenceIntentions.text: Something can be beautiful enough to hold your attention and still deserve your rejection.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Let beauty coexist with justified rejection
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel the tension of admiring something troubling

sentenceIntentions.text: Beauty: The Anatomy of Fascination explores the attraction that makes that tension possible.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Name the book's inquiry into attraction
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Understand fascination itself is under examination

sentenceIntentions.text: It moves from an elegant proof to an intimate face, and from music to political spectacle.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Move between proof, intimacy, music and spectacle
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Expect varied experiences rather than a single beauty formula

sentenceIntentions.text: These encounters ask what beauty shows us, what we add to it, and what admiration can excuse.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Question the leap from attraction to authority

sentenceIntentions.text: The book connects philosophy with psychology, culture, bodies, and the histories of familiar objects.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Situate beauty in minds, bodies and cultural histories

sentenceIntentions.text: An inherited possession and its perfect copy can look alike while offering different experiences.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Contrast an inherited possession with its copy
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Recognize that identical appearance need not mean identical experience

sentenceIntentions.text: An attraction you struggled to explain becomes a reason to look more closely.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Make personal fascination worthy of inquiry
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel invited to understand an attachment without reducing it

sentenceIntentions.text: Begin with the opening encounters, and look again at something you already find beautiful.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Return to something already beautiful to the viewer
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Want to look again with a more demanding question
